resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Arabic source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review checks, typecheck, complete build, route and generated-link checks, and the full test suite passed after the cycle was finalized.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Arabic pass identified six trigonometry terminology, formula, and title defects; all six were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Arabic human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted for this cycle.

findings.summary: The right-triangles heading used صحيحة, meaning correct, instead of the standard Arabic term for right-angled triangles.
evidence: The previous title was المثلثات الصحيحة.

findings.summary: The trigonometry explanation called sine cosine and used inconsistent names for the opposite side.
evidence: The previous paragraph said جيب التمام for the sine ratio and used المعاكس for the tangent numerator.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the paragraph with the standard Arabic terms الجيب, جيب التمام, الظل, المقابل, and المجاور.

findings.summary: The sine formula retained English side labels.
evidence: The previous expression was sin(θ) = opposite / hypotenuse.
findings.resolution: Changed it to sin(θ) = المقابل / الوتر.

findings.summary: The cosine formula retained English side labels.
evidence: The previous expression was cos(θ) = adjacent / hypotenuse.
findings.resolution: Changed it to cos(θ) = المجاور / الوتر.

findings.summary: The tangent formula retained English side labels.
evidence: The previous expression was tan(θ) = opposite / adjacent.
findings.resolution: Changed it to tan(θ) = المقابل / المجاور.

findings.summary: The unknown-sides heading used الجوانب, a general word for sides, instead of the standard geometric term الأضلاع.
evidence: The previous title was إيجاد الجوانب والزوايا المجهولة.
findings.resolution: Changed it to إيجاد الأضلاع والزوايا المجهولة.
